<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><b>2019 Stock incentive plan</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The omnibus 2019 stock incentive plan permits
the Board of Directors of the Company to grant options to employees and non-employees to acquire common shares of the Company at fair
market value on the date of approval by the Board of Directors. Vesting is determined on an award-by-award basis.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">There were a total of <span id="xdx_904_eus-gaap--ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardOptionsGrantsInPeriodGross_c20250101__20251231__us-gaap--PlanNameAxis__custom--TwoThousandNineteenStockIncentivePlanMember_zxPGmy5iE2n1" title="Options granted shares">579,744</span> and <span id="xdx_90C_eus-gaap--ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardOptionsGrantsInPeriodGross_c20240101__20241231__us-gaap--PlanNameAxis__custom--TwoThousandNineteenStockIncentivePlanMember_z9CyaeQZH4Ih" title="Options granted shares">6,180,833</span> options
granted during the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, respectively. As of December 31, 2025 and 2024, there were <span id="xdx_906_ecustom--ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardOptionOutstandingNumber_iI_c20251231__us-gaap--PlanNameAxis__custom--TwoThousandNineteenStockIncentivePlanMember_zN8lkW7wZJG5" title="Options outstanding shares">12,042,060</span> and
<span id="xdx_90C_eus-gaap--ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardOptionsOutstandingNumber_iI_c20241231__us-gaap--PlanNameAxis__custom--TwoThousandNineteenStockIncentivePlanMember_zNM83gSBoQqb" title="Options outstanding shares">13,815,048</span>, respectively, options outstanding. For the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, there was $<span id="xdx_903_eus-gaap--EmployeeBenefitsAndShareBasedCompensation_c20250101__20251231__us-gaap--PlanNameAxis__custom--TwoThousandNineteenStockIncentivePlanMember_zim0v3jVxXIh" title="Share based compensation expense">967,579</span> and $<span id="xdx_909_eus-gaap--EmployeeBenefitsAndShareBasedCompensation_c20240101__20241231__us-gaap--PlanNameAxis__custom--TwoThousandNineteenStockIncentivePlanMember_zSUbG1zF6L2a" title="Share based compensation expense">428,108</span>, respectively,
of share-based compensation expense related to the 2019 stock incentive plan. For the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, there were
<span id="xdx_905_eus-gaap--StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesStockOptionsExercised_c20250101__20251231__us-gaap--PlanNameAxis__custom--TwoThousandNineteenStockIncentivePlanMember_zSbQ2lW7b9Uh" title="Stock options exercised">302,666</span> and <span id="xdx_905_eus-gaap--StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesStockOptionsExercised_c20240101__20241231__us-gaap--PlanNameAxis__custom--TwoThousandNineteenStockIncentivePlanMember_zMp0gfE63aYe" title="Stock options exercised">0</span> options exercised. All option exercises were on a cashless basis.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><b>Restricted Share Unit Plan</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">In December 2022, the Company formally
adopted the Restricted Share Unit Plan (&#8220;RSU Plan&#8221;). The RSU Plan permits the Board of Directors of the Company to grant
Restricted Share Units (&#8220;RSU&#8217;s&#8221;) to employees and non-employees to acquire common shares of the Company at fair
market value on the date of approval by the Board of Directors. Vesting is determined on an award-by-award basis. The granted shares
are not considered outstanding until exercised. During the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, <span id="xdx_90D_ecustom--ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardEquityInstrumentsOtherThanOptionsGrants_c20250101__20251231__us-gaap--PlanNameAxis__custom--RestrictedShareUnitPlanMember_zyloJgASdzC8" title="Granted shares">26,084,258</span>
and <span id="xdx_907_ecustom--ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardEquityInstrumentsOtherThanOptionsGrants_c20240101__20241231__us-gaap--PlanNameAxis__custom--RestrictedShareUnitPlanMember_zxWepRyiUsSe" title="Granted shares">6,939,253</span>
units were granted, <span id="xdx_90F_eus-gaap--ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardEquityInstrumentsOtherThanOptionsVestedInPeriod_c20250101__20251231__us-gaap--PlanNameAxis__custom--RestrictedShareUnitPlanMember_zmyghSqx9LR8">10,128,496</span>
and <span id="xdx_90C_eus-gaap--ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardEquityInstrumentsOtherThanOptionsVestedInPeriod_c20240101__20241231__us-gaap--PlanNameAxis__custom--RestrictedShareUnitPlanMember_zy8OAhd77545">1,330,852</span>
units were vested, <span id="xdx_90C_eus-gaap--ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardEquityInstrumentsOtherThanOptionsForfeitedInPeriod_c20250101__20251231__us-gaap--PlanNameAxis__custom--RestrictedShareUnitPlanMember_zUQOf6wOGgPi" title="Forfeited shares">7,380</span>
and <span id="xdx_909_eus-gaap--ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardEquityInstrumentsOtherThanOptionsForfeitedInPeriod_dxL_c20240101__20241231__us-gaap--PlanNameAxis__custom--RestrictedShareUnitPlanMember_zziH9F1Idoi7" title="Forfeited shares::XDX::-"><span style="-sec-ix-hidden: xdx2ixbrl2451">0</span></span>
were forfeited, and <span id="xdx_901_ecustom--ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardEquityInstrumentsOtherThanOptionsExercisedInPeriod_c20250101__20251231__us-gaap--PlanNameAxis__custom--RestrictedShareUnitPlanMember_zUhSoxStIdeb" title="Exercised shares value">7,185,206</span>

were exercised, respectively. For the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, the Company recognized share-based compensation
expense of $<span id="xdx_902_eus-gaap--ShareBasedCompensation_c20250101__20251231__us-gaap--PlanNameAxis__custom--RestrictedShareUnitPlanMember_znkXLSsQpD1f">1,470,020</span>

    <td style="font-size: 10pt; text-align: left">&#160;</td><td style="font-size: 10pt; text-align: right"><span id="xdx_90B_eus-gaap--ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardFairValueAssumptionsExpectedDividendRate_pid_dp_uPure_c20240101__20241231__us-gaap--PlanNameAxis__custom--RestrictedShareUnitPlanMember_z49QxMzfjVD3">0.00</span></td><td style="font-size: 10pt; text-align: left">%</td></tr>
  </table>

<p id="xdx_8A3_zUWiSBv5qN12" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><b>Reserves</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 7.55pt; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">Reserves includes accumulated foreign currency
translation adjustments and the accumulated fair value of share-based compensation and warrants transferred from share-based payment
reserve and warrant reserve upon cancellation or expiry of the share options and warrants.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"></p>

</td>
</tr>
</table>
